name: Steak, Asparagus & Bell Pepper Stir Fry

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water with cornstarch until smooth. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and red pepper; whisk together. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp cold water
3 tsp cornstarch
6 tbsp soy sauce
3 tsp toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash the fresh produce. Snap (or cut) off woody ends from the asparagus, then cut on an angle into 5 cm pieces; transfer to a large bowl. Seed and cut the bell peppers into 5 cm strips; add to the bowl with asparagus. Trim green onion ends and chop on an angle; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic. Transfer both to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the steak into thin strips.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the steak strips and cook until browned, 1-2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Once steak has been transferred, add more oil to the skillet. Add the asparagus, bell pepper, ginger, and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables are crisp-tender and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes.
Return beef to the skillet and add green onions and sauce. Cook until sauce is slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, place stir fry in a bowl and enjoy!
